cloakroom: Cloakroom facility for footwear and personal belongings outside the temple main entrance.
drinking_water: Uninterrupted drinking water supply facilities throughout the temple premises and queue complexes.
toilets: Clean public toilet complexes (Sulabh Shauchalay) near the river bank and temple entrance.
footwear_counter: Cloakroom/footwear deposit facility outside the main entrance.
annadanam: Free Annadanam (Nityannadanam) canteen facility providing free wholesome vegetarian meals during lunch hours (12:00 PM – 2:30 PM).
wheelchair_accessibility: Manual wheelchairs are available at the main entry point for senior citizens and differently-abled pilgrims.
parking: Parking facilities are available at the TG Tourism Haritha Hotel and nearby areas.
other_facilities: Bathing ghats with safety railings and dress changing rooms for ladies at the Triveni Sangam river bank.
Sanitation and waste disposal in the temple precinct.
Medical assistance and first-aid facility through the local Primary Health Centre (PHC) Kaleshwaram.
Free Darshanam (Sarva Darshanam) queue line system.
Free distribution of holy prasadam to devotees after completing darshan.
Regular TSRTC bus transportation connecting Kaleshwaram to Manthani, Godavarikhani, Karimnagar, Hanamkonda (Warangal), and Bhupalpally.
